meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 给 Claude 加上 DeltaChat 渠道:通过你的邮箱收发消息,走 Autocrypt/OpenPGP 端到端加密,支持双向文件附件,可在 DeltaChat 私聊或群里与它对话。
howto.when: 当你要求为 Claude 添加 DeltaChat 渠道,或在 /setup 流程中接入渠道,或用 /init-first-agent 把某个 DeltaChat 聊天接到 agent 时接管。

say.text: 帮我给 Claude 加上 DeltaChat 渠道,用我这个邮箱收发消息。
say.note: 会走安装步骤并把凭据写入 .env

say.text: 把这个 DeltaChat 群接到我的 agent 上。
say.note: host 服务需在运行,用 ncl 建立接线

say.text: 这张图设成机器人头像,说明写 /set-avatar。
say.note: 仅 owner 或 admin 可用

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel to Claude: messages go over your email with Autocrypt/OpenPGP end-to-end encryption, file attachments work both ways, and you can chat with it in DeltaChat DMs or groups.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add a DeltaChat channel, or during /setup to wire a new channel, or when /init-first-agent connects a DeltaChat chat to an agent.

say_en.text: Add a DeltaChat channel to Claude using my email account.
say_en.note: Runs install steps and writes .env credentials

say_en.text: Wire this DeltaChat group to my agent.
say_en.note: Host service must be running; uses ncl

say_en.text: Set this image as the bot avatar with caption /set-avatar.
